type EqualFn<T> = (lhs: T, rhs: T) => boolean
type GetterFn<T> = () => T
type SetterFn<T> = (value: T) => T
type UnsubscribeFn = () => void
type UpdateFn<T> = (value?: T) => T

type InputPair<T> = [GetterFn<T>, SetterFn<T>]

type Options = {
  name: string // for debugging
}

type CellKind = 'input' | 'compute' | 'callback'

/** Erased cell reference used to build the dependency graph. */
type AnyCell = Cell<any>

/**
 * Bumped once per propagation so every cell can tell whether it
 * changed "during the current update" by comparing against the
 * generation it was last marked with.
 */
let generation = 0

/** The cell whose `updateFn` is currently executing (dependency tracking). */
let activeObserver: AnyCell | undefined

class Cell<T> {
  readonly kind: CellKind
  readonly name?: string
  readonly dependents: Set<AnyCell> = new Set()
  readonly dependencies: Set<AnyCell> = new Set()
  updateFn?: UpdateFn<T>
  equalFn?: EqualFn<T>
  value: T | undefined
  /** Longest path from an input; used to update cells in dependency order. */
  depth = 0
  /** Marks the cell as part of the propagation currently in flight. */
  dirty = false
  /** Generation in which this cell last reported a change. */
  changedAt = -1
  alive = true

  constructor(kind, value, name?) { ... }

  read = (): T => {
    const observer = activeObserver
    if (observer !== undefined && observer !== this) {
      this.dependents.add(observer)
      observer.dependencies.add(this)
    }
    return this.value as T
  }
}
